schedule.name: Adult: diabetes
schedule.description: Diabetes mellitus. Applies on top of the adult age schedule only for patients a clinician has put on it; its rules replace the age rule for the same vaccine.

rules.review_reason: Pneumococcal: choose PCV15 (then PPSV23 at least 1 year later; 8 weeks if immunocompromised), PCV20 or PCV21. Check earlier PCV13 and PPSV23 doses first.
rules.why_text: CDC adult schedule 2025, diabetes: age 19 or older, 1 dose of PCV15, PCV20 or PCV21 if no earlier conjugate vaccine

rules.review_reason: Hepatitis B: 2, 3 or 4 doses depending on the vaccine used (2 doses for Heplisav-B). Dialysis uses the dialysis formulation. Check the series.
rules.why_text: CDC adult schedule 2025, diabetes: diabetes is a hepatitis B risk factor; at age 60 or older it is by shared clinical decision-making

rules.review_reason: Age 50 to 74: 1 dose RSV vaccine if diabetes is complicated by kidney disease, neuropathy, retinopathy or other end-organ damage, or needs insulin or an SGLT2 inhibitor. Confirm.
rules.why_text: CDC adult schedule 2025, diabetes: 1 dose RSV vaccine at 50 to 74 with increased risk
